title_en: Build Publisher with subscribe and notify
spec_html_en: Write class Publisher. __init__(self) sets up an empty list of subscribers. subscribe(self, callback) adds callback to that list. notify(self, event) calls every subscribed callback with event, in the order they subscribed.
test:
def test_notifies_single_subscriber():
    received = []
    publisher = Publisher()
    publisher.subscribe(lambda event: received.append(event))
    publisher.notify('breaking news')
    assert received == ['breaking news'], 'notify must call the subscribed callback with the event'

def test_notifies_multiple_subscribers_in_order():
    received = []
    publisher = Publisher()
    publisher.subscribe(lambda event: received.append(('a', event)))
    publisher.subscribe(lambda event: received.append(('b', event)))
    publisher.notify('update')
    assert received == [('a', 'update'), ('b', 'update')], 'notify must call every subscriber, in the order they subscribed'

def test_no_subscribers_does_not_raise():
    publisher = Publisher()
    publisher.notify('anything')
